Title: AKS legacy Azure AD integration will be retired on 29 February 2024

Body.Content:
Because Azure Kubernetes Service now uses Managed Azure Active Directory to simplify the Active Directory integration process, we will be retiring the legacy Azure Active Directory Integration on 29 February 2024. Any Azure Kubernetes Service cluster using the legacy Azure Active Directory integration will be unsupported after 29 February 2024. Please transition to using the Managed Azure Active Directory Integration by that date. 

Action required 

To avoid or minimize disruption to your Azure Kubernetes Service cluster transition to AKS-managed Azure AD before 29 February 2024.  

More information 

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, please create a support request.
